summary: Verified database.py initializes the SQLite tasks table with id, title, status, and created_at (including valid-status enforcement).

messages.content: Database schema is ready: tasks includes id, title, status, created_at; status is constrained to todo, in_progress, done. It also includes user_id for the existing authenticated API.

decisions: Kept the existing compatible tasks schema, which already fulfilled db-1 and preserves the user_id column required by server.py.
